major_cooldowns.name: Tranquility
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Pre-plan it for the fight's worst damage and start ramping 15-20 seconds out with Swiftmend, Rejuvenation and a wall of Regrowth so the channel extends every HoT by 10 seconds.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 740 is the cast and self aura carried by all five sampled parses; the same-name 157982 is not observed.

major_cooldowns.name: Convoke the Spirits
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Channel it in caster form in raid with a Wild Growth already out, and keep Cat Form casts for dungeon packs where the group wants damage instead of healing.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 391528 is the cast id in all five parses; the guide links the same-name 323764, which the parses do not carry.

major_cooldowns.name: Incarnation: Tree of Life
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it 10-12 seconds before major damage so the discounted Rejuvenations land first, and channel Tranquility inside it because the tree pauses while you channel.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses, which all ran Convoke the Spirits, but castable per its tooltip. Base cooldown is 180s; the guide says Grove Guardian cooldown reduction brings it to roughly 100s with good play.

major_cooldowns.name: Nature's Swiftness
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Self-cast it into Regrowth during dangerous damage so Overgrowth refreshes your own HoTs, or aim it at anyone who drops very low.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 132158 is the cast and aura observed in all five parses; the same-name 378081 is not carried.

major_cooldowns.name: Innervate
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Give it to a healer who is already burning mana so the full 20% regenerates instead of overflowing.

defensives.name: Barkskin
defensives.usage_rule: Press it into any hit you can see coming, since it also stops that damage from pushing back your casts.

defensives.name: Ironbark
defensives.usage_rule: Drop it on the tank or whoever is about to eat a spike, and keep it for yourself when the hit is aimed at you.

defensives.name: Frenzied Regeneration
defensives.usage_rule: Shift to Bear Form and press it when you need a chunk of your own health back immediately.
defensives.id_note: 22842 shows up in four of five parses as a self aura only; it is the cast id per its tooltip row.

rules.action: Refresh Lifebloom on yourself before it expires so the Everbloom healing never stops.

rules.description: Refresh Lifebloom late for the bloom
rules.action: Refresh Lifebloom inside its last 4.5 seconds so it blooms instead of being clipped early.

rules.description: Efflorescence stays down at all times
rules.action: Replace Efflorescence as soon as it expires, under your Lifebloom target or under yourself.

rules.description: Abundance stays up from five Rejuvenations
rules.action: Batch five Rejuvenations onto the group before damage lands, pressing Swiftmend first to spread three at once.

rules.description: Wild Growth before Convoke the Spirits
rules.action: Send Wild Growth out first so the Flourish extension from Convoke has fresh HoTs to stretch.
Put Wild Growth and a wall of Regrowth out just before you channel so Tranquility extends them.
